resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Ukrainian source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Ukrainian pass identified 25 actionable terminology, grammar, technical-clarity, circuit, thermal, and wire-gauge defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Ukrainian human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The relationship heading was rendered as a literal relationship rather than a natural Ukrainian technical heading.
evidence: The previous title was Відносини.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Співвідношення.

findings.summary: The heading used an unnatural calque for rearranged formulas.
evidence: The previous title was Переставлені формули.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Перетворені формули.

findings.summary: The zero-resistance warning used an awkward literal construction.
evidence: The previous text said Опір нуль Ω and used звертатися окремо.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with numeric 0 Ω and natural Ukrainian safety wording.

findings.summary: The heating-power introduction used an unnatural compound for electrical heating.
evidence: The previous text was Потужність електронагріву становить.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Потужність електричного нагрівання становить.

findings.summary: The worked-example heading was a false-friend translation.
evidence: The previous title was Спрацьований приклад.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Опрацьований приклад.

findings.summary: The setup used несе for current through a coil, which is not the clearest electrical wording.
evidence: The previous setup said Котушка 0,8 Ω несе 3 А.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as current passing through a coil with 0.8 Ω resistance.

findings.summary: The dative and instrumental forms in the heat-transfer sentence were incorrect.
evidence: The previous text used Теплопередача повітрю, рідині та обладнанням.
findings.resolution: Changed it to natural heat transfer to air, liquid, and equipment.

findings.summary: The paragraph described heat leaving a surface with awkward and ambiguous wording.
evidence: The previous paragraph used literal energy-transfer wording and did not clearly distinguish heat-flux density.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to distinguish power, temperature, heat capacity, and heat-flux density.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms heading was too generic in Ukrainian.
evidence: The previous title was Терміни схеми.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Терміни електричної схеми.

findings.summary: The loop definition used a hyphenated calque and the wrong noun for a circuit loop.
evidence: The previous text began Петля - це замкнутий шлях.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a natural definition using Контур and Ukrainian punctuation.

findings.summary: The series-and-parallel heading was less natural than the standard connection terminology.
evidence: The previous title was Послідовні та паралельні кола.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Послідовне та паралельне з’єднання.

findings.summary: The battery-cell heading used Клітини, which is a misleading literal translation in this context.
evidence: The previous title was Клітини послідовно і паралельно.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Елементи послідовно та паралельно.

findings.summary: The series-cell capacity sentence used awkward agreement and an unclear reference to an equal cell.
evidence: The previous sentence ended with як у однієї рівної клітини.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with standard Ukrainian battery-element terminology and clear capacity wording.

findings.summary: The lithium-ion charging warning used серійне and described monitoring less precisely.
evidence: The previous text referred to Серійне заряджання літій-іонних батарей and monitoring at element level.
findings.resolution: Changed it to послідовне charging of lithium-ion elements with per-element voltage control.

findings.summary: The circuit-solving step used a literal word for simultaneous equations.
evidence: The previous text said Розв’яжіть симультанні рівняння.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Розв’яжіть систему рівнянь.

findings.summary: The TCR worked-example heading repeated the false-friend translation Спрацьований.
evidence: The previous title was Спрацьований приклад.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Опрацьований приклад.

findings.summary: The TCR paragraph used the unnatural phrase позитивного опору TCR.
evidence: The previous paragraph described Для позитивного опору TCR.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with додатний TCR and clearer constant-voltage wording.

findings.summary: The triangle setup used перетинає кут, which is not a meaningful geometric relation here.
evidence: The previous setup was Гіпотенуза 10 см перетинає кут 30°.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to state that the 10 cm hypotenuse is opposite the 30° angle.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity worked-example heading used the same false-friend translation.
evidence: The previous title was Спрацьований приклад.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Опрацьований приклад.

findings.summary: The object-versus-material heading used a literal против construction that sounds adversarial rather than comparative.
evidence: The previous title was Об'єкт проти матеріалу.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Об’єкт і матеріал.

findings.summary: The paragraph used відноситься for a technical relationship and an awkward object phrase.
evidence: The previous text said Теплоємність відноситься до всього об'єкта.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with стосується and natural Ukrainian grammar.

findings.summary: The display name omitted that heat flux is an areal density, which can be confused with total heat flow.
evidence: The previous display name was Тепловий потік.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Густина теплового потоку.

findings.summary: The practical check used an infinitive fragment instead of an instruction and used the less precise heat-flow term.
evidence: The previous text began Відрізнити середній тепловий потік.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a direct instruction using average heat-flux density and local peak.

findings.summary: The gauge-number explanation had unnatural word order and an unclear phrase for sizes above zero gauge.
evidence: The previous text began Більше звичайне калібрувальне число.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with standard Ukrainian gauge-number terminology.

findings.summary: The wire-sizing check called current capacity поточна потужність and used the wrong term for gauge number.
evidence: The previous text asked readers to determine поточну потужність by номером датчика.
findings.resolution: Changed it to допустимий струм and номер калібру.
